summary: The Counter refactor introduces a stale-closure bug in useEffect and drops support for the initial prop. The functional setState update is a good change.

acceptanceCriteria.note: CI status cannot be verified from the diff alone.
PR title not provided in fixture.
E2E is not a merge gate yet.

findings.title: initial prop is ignored after refactor
findings.description: useState was changed from useState(initial) to useState(0), so callers passing a non-zero initial value will always start at 0.
findings.suggestion: Restore useState(initial) or useState(() => initial) so the prop is honored.

findings.title: useEffect reads count with an empty dependency array
findings.description: document.title uses count but the effect depends on []. The title is set once on mount and never updates when count changes.
findings.suggestion: Add count to the dependency array: useEffect(() => { document.title = `Count: ${count}`; }, [count]);

findings.title: Document title side effect couples UI to global DOM
findings.description: Updating document.title inside Counter makes the component harder to test and reuse outside a page context.
findings.suggestion: Move title updates to a parent route/layout or a dedicated usePageTitle hook.
